direction: Engineering notebook: warm paper, graph-paper grid in pale blueprint blue, ink navy type, ONE red-pen accent for the teacher's marks (rough circles, strike-outs, stamps, the answer). Math set in JetBrains Mono, headlines in Space Grotesk. Elements sit on the grid; results land as rubber-stamp slams with a small paper jolt. No gradients, no glow, no dark-tech.

devices.graphPaper: fine grid every 2.5u at 0.14 alpha + major every 10u at 0.26; paper grain tiles at 24 fps, 0.05 alpha
devices.redPen: the only accent: rough hand-drawn circle, strike-out X bands, underlines, stamps — the teacher's marks
devices.matrixObject: one bracketed matrix travels and morphs through the whole film; rows/cols cross out so 2x2 minors peel off and fly to their slots
devices.stamp: results land from 1.28x scale on a HEAVY spring with a 0.4s noise-based paper jolt — no glow
devices.chip: mono margin note top-left, one per section, red bullet, swaps with a rise
